# Kelvon Agee

> Producer, Director, and Director of Photography based in New York and Los Angeles. A 5x Emmy-nominated cinematographer. The portfolio is presented as a single infinite canvas of selected frames, with a cinematography reel.

Kelvon Agee has over a decade of experience crafting authentic stories through a cinematic lens. His work spans award-nominated documentaries including Deadliest Catch and Life Below Zero — more than 200 produced and 130 directed hours of prime-time programming — alongside campaigns and branded content for high-profile clients.
